records.name: TI TPS22917 reverse-current-blocking load switch
records.description: Always-on 1 V to 5.5 V, 2 A load switch with full-time reverse-current blocking and controlled rise time.

companions.description: Leave CT and QOD open for the reviewed default rise-time and disabled output-discharge configuration.

notes: TI specifies full-time reverse-current blocking, 1 V to 5.5 V operation, 2 A maximum continuous current, and 120 mOhm typical on-resistance at 1.8 V.

records.name: TI TPS26600 programmable industrial eFuse
records.description: 4.2 V to 60 V industrial eFuse with adjustable 0.1 A to 2.23 A current limiting, controlled output ramp, reverse-polarity protection, external overvoltage cutoff, and low-IQ shutdown.

companions.description: Leave the optional monitor, fault, and no-connect functions open when the realization does not expose monitoring.

notes: Current-limit bounds use TI guaranteed 0.085 A to 0.115 A limits at 120 kOhm and are recomputed conservatively when the provider selects RILIM.
External OVP is limited to 55 V and must be programmed above the design input envelope.
The exposed pad is electrically tied to RTN and requires the reviewed thermal-via footprint.

records.description: Precision bidirectional shunt amplifier for high-side sensing across a -4 V to 80 V common-mode range.

uncertainties.source: TI INA240 Rev. C gain error
TI INA240 Rev. C input offset

records.name: TI INA168 60 V micropower current-shunt monitor
records.description: Micropower high-side current-shunt monitor with a current output programmed by an external load resistor; this reviewed 50 kOhm configuration realizes 10 V/V voltage gain.

uncertainties.source: TI INA168 Rev. G transconductance over temperature with 50 kOhm output load
TI INA168 Rev. G output offset over temperature referred through the reviewed gain

notes: TI specifies 2.7 V to 60 V operation, 60 uA maximum quiescent current over temperature, 200 uA/V nominal output transconductance, 2 percent maximum transconductance error over temperature, and 2 mV maximum output offset. A reviewed 50 kOhm output load converts the current output to 10 V/V voltage gain. The 80 kHz model bandwidth is conservative between the published 800 kHz result at 5 kOhm and 32 kHz result at 125 kOhm. The single physical ground pin uses the current-sense primitive's reviewed ground-referenced defaults for absent reference and secondary-ground terminals.

records.name: TI INA149 high-common-mode difference amplifier
records.description: Unity-gain precision difference amplifier for bidirectional shunt sensing across bipolar load paths; the conservative single-5-V model retains the specified -20 V to 25 V common-mode range.

uncertainties.source: TI INA149 Rev. B maximum initial gain error
TI INA149 Rev. B maximum initial offset

notes: TI SBOS579B specifies unity gain, 500 kHz bandwidth, -20 V to 25 V common-mode operation from a single 5 V supply, dual reference inputs, and SOIC-8 pinout. The installed INA128 symbol is used only as a pin-position-compatible graphical carrier; catalog function-to-pin mappings are authoritative.

records.name: TRACO Power TEC 3-2411UI protected isolated 5 V converter
records.description: Three-watt 9 V to 75 V input regulated 5 V converter with remote shutdown, short-circuit protection, over-current limiting, under-voltage lockout, and 2 kV isolation.

companions.description: Leave package pins 5 and 8 unconnected as required by the reviewed single-output pin map.

notes: The datasheet specifies 12 A as typical input inrush, not a guaranteed maximum; maximum-inrush requirements therefore require an independently bounded protection stage.
The 45.2 K/W case-to-ambient value and 110 C maximum case temperature are modeled as the reviewed module thermal path; workload-specific EMC and isolation-spacing checks remain required.

records.name: TRACO Power TRI 10-1212 reinforced-isolation 12 V converter
records.description: Ten-watt 9 V to 18 V input regulated 12 V converter with reinforced 1 kVAC working isolation, continuous short-circuit protection, and 5 kVAC production isolation test.

notes: The effective 24.6 K/W module thermal path is conservatively derived from the datasheet's 10 W full-load operation through 65 C ambient, 105 C maximum case temperature, and 86% typical efficiency.
The 1.5827 A short-circuit bound is the datasheet's 190% maximum current limit applied to the 0.833 A rated output.
The converter has no remote-control pin; system shutdown must be implemented by an upstream reviewed protection stage.

records.name: TI ISO7741FDW reinforced quad-channel digital isolator
records.description: Default-low, 100 Mbps, three-forward/one-reverse push-pull digital isolator with independent 2.25 V to 5.5 V supplies and a 1.5 kV rms reviewed working-isolation envelope.

notes: The installed KiCad library has no ISO7741 symbol, so a generic numbered 16-pin symbol preserves the exact DW pin map.
The F suffix is required for the reviewed default-low behavior when an input-side supply or signal is absent; EN low instead makes the corresponding output side high impedance.
The reusable output-current envelope is limited to 1 mA so the model remains valid across the full 2.25 V to 5.5 V supply range.
Static quiescent load uses the published typical per-channel DC consumption as a bounded reduced-order thermal estimate; higher activity requires frequency-specific supply-current evidence.

records.name: Analog Devices ADuM1252 bidirectional I2C isolator
records.description: Hot-swappable two-channel I2C isolator with independent 1.71 V to 5.5 V supplies and a 3 kV rms isolation rating.

notes: A generic numbered eight-pin KiCad symbol is used because the installed KiCad library has no ADuM1252 symbol; the catalog pin map preserves the exact datasheet pin numbers.
